phase: PHASE 21 — ZUPT CORRECTION AND REGRESSION VALIDATION
scientific_verdict: ZUPT BUG CORRECTED — BLACKOUT RE-EVALUATION REQUIRED

root_cause_summary.issue: False stationary detection during constant-velocity cruising
root_cause_summary.mechanism: StationaryDetector previously evaluated only specific force magnitude consistency (| ||a|| - g | <= 1.5) and low acceleration variance (var(||a||) < 0.15). During smooth, unaccelerated straight-line cruising, specific force equals gravity (9.81 m/s^2) and variance is near zero. Consequently, StationaryDetector falsely latched stationary=True on 116 of 300 frames during the 30s blackout, triggering apply_zupt() which crushed EKF velocity to zero on moving frames.
root_cause_summary.correction: Multi-modal moving-vs-stationary gate implemented: (1) requires kinematic consistency with current speed (speed <= 0.8 m/s), (2) multi-frame persistence hysteresis (2 consecutive quiet frames to latch), and (3) immediate unlatching upon motion detection.

secondary_effects_identified.heading_drift: Velocity magnitude is now accurately integrated, but residual position error reflects heading/yaw orientation error during unobserved turns.
secondary_effects_identified.phone_to_vehicle_alignment: Requires full 3D rotation transform rather than uncalibrated 1D axial feed.
secondary_effects_identified.gyro_bias_observability: Gyro bias integrates into yaw drift during GNSS outages.
